qualityStandard.style: academic studio quality with clean botanical reference visuals
qualityStandard.palette: cream, green, neutral, botanical natural tones
rules: Readable labels at normal website size
Works as website art and print-friendly reference
One clear teaching purpose per visual

assets.title: Healthy Fan Leaf Reference Plate
assets.brief: High-detail healthy cannabis fan leaf on clean cream background, top and underside reference, visible petiole, leaflets, serrations, midrib and secondary veins, natural green color, no yellow tint, studio lighting, educational label space.
assets.altTextDraft: Healthy cannabis fan leaf reference showing leaflets, veins, petiole, serrations, and upper and lower surface comparison.

assets.title: Leaf Anatomy Labeled Diagram
assets.brief: Clean labeled cannabis fan leaf diagram with petiole, central leaflet, lateral leaflets, blade, margin, serration, midrib, secondary veins, upper surface, lower surface, and leaflet tip. Cream background, dark green labels, high readability.
assets.altTextDraft: Labeled cannabis fan leaf anatomy diagram identifying petiole, leaflets, serrations, midrib, veins, and leaf surfaces.

assets.title: Stomata Open vs Closed Diagram
assets.brief: Two-panel educational diagram showing open and closed stomata with guard cells, stomatal pore, CO2 entry, water vapor exit, and connection to VPD. Scientific but simple, clean labels, no decorative clutter.
assets.altTextDraft: Open and closed stomata diagram showing guard cells, gas exchange, water vapor loss, and VPD connection.

assets.title: Transpiration Root-to-Leaf Flow
assets.brief: Root-to-leaf process diagram showing water uptake at roots, movement through xylem, leaf vein distribution, stomatal water vapor exit, and environmental demand. Clean arrows, accurate plant structure, print-friendly labels.
assets.altTextDraft: Transpiration flow diagram showing water uptake from roots, movement through xylem, and vapor release through leaf stomata.

assets.title: Chlorosis Pattern Comparison Chart
assets.brief: Five-panel cannabis leaf comparison showing uniform chlorosis, interveinal chlorosis, marginal yellowing, old-growth-first yellowing, and new-growth-first yellowing. Same scale, consistent lighting, clear labels, no diagnosis claims on image.
assets.altTextDraft: Comparison chart of cannabis leaf chlorosis patterns including uniform, interveinal, marginal, old-growth-first, and new-growth-first yellowing.

assets.title: Necrosis Pattern Comparison Chart
assets.brief: Five-panel cannabis leaf comparison showing tip burn, marginal necrosis, rust spots, irregular lesions, and necrosis following chlorosis. Clean neutral background, high-detail tissue edges, clear labels.
assets.altTextDraft: Comparison chart of cannabis leaf necrosis patterns including tip burn, marginal necrosis, rust spots, irregular lesions, and dead tissue following chlorosis.

assets.title: Leaf Curl Pattern Chart
assets.brief: Cannabis leaf posture comparison showing upward tacoing, downward clawing, wilted droop, twisted new growth, and cupping. Include simple direction arrows, clean labels, and consistent scale.
assets.altTextDraft: Cannabis leaf curl comparison chart showing tacoing, clawing, drooping, twisting, and cupping patterns.

assets.title: Leaf Pest Damage Comparison Chart
assets.brief: Macro reference grid showing common visible pest evidence on cannabis leaves: stippling, webbing, eggs under leaf, frass, chewing marks, silvering, trails, and distorted new tips. Avoid pesticide advice; focus on inspection evidence.
assets.altTextDraft: Cannabis leaf pest damage comparison chart showing stippling, webbing, eggs, frass, chewing, silvering, trails, and distorted tips.

assets.title: Nutrient Symptom Triage Visual
assets.brief: Decision-map style visual showing how to separate deficiency-like symptoms from pH issue, EC issue, root stress, watering issue, environmental stress, and pest damage. Use observation-first language, not absolute diagnosis claims.
assets.altTextDraft: Nutrient symptom triage map comparing deficiency-like leaf symptoms with pH, EC, root stress, watering, environment, and pest checks.

assets.title: Environmental Canopy Stress Map
assets.brief: Whole-plant canopy map showing likely stress zones: top canopy light/heat stress, dense interior humidity risk, lower-canopy shading, airflow dead zones, and root-zone demand connection. Clean arrows and labels.
assets.altTextDraft: Canopy stress map showing light and heat stress at the top, humidity risk in dense canopy, lower-canopy shading, airflow dead zones, and root-zone demand.
